archive_format: zip (deflate, level 6), flat — 400 .npy at the archive root, no directory prefix

archive_verified.method: re-fetched with GITHUB_TOKEN and GH_TOKEN cleared from the environment, so the fetch could not succeed on cached credentials

outputs.filenames: byte-identical to the inputs; no suffix, no extension change

validation.asserted: dtype float32, ndim 2, shape (256,256), all finite, within [0,1], filename set identical to the input set

ground_truth: none exists. The released test set ships inputs only, so no score can be computed against it. Every metric in this repository is measured on a held-out split of train/.
note: The .npy files are NOT committed. 400 outputs at 256x256 float32 is ~105 MB raw, which would require loosening V51's 5 MB per-file and 25 MB total-tree caps. See docs/decisions.md D23 and D31.
